label: D1 after a1 -> rare S2 -> unrewarded (model-based stay-on-a1 signal)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2), only when the reward input is 0, and only when the previous choice was a1 and that trial went rare to S2 (in every case where the previous trial is in the window); all observed variables. This is the rare-unrewarded case after a1, where a model-based agent should repeat a1, and the next choice is almost always a1 (only 22 of 11956 activations precede a2). The other ~18% of activations are at the window first D1 (rel -3), where the previous trial is not in the window, so they are unscorable rather than real exceptions. Precision is low (~0.36): the unit fires on only about a third of qualifying steps. Adding the good state, the trial before that, value or choice logit does not help. Firing is rarer at the start (trials 0-9) and end (80-99) of the episode, and restricting to trials 10-84 raises F1 to 0.56. Magnitude is about the same across activation quartiles (coverage is flat), so the predicate does not explain magnitude. It never fires after a reward, after a2, or after a common transition.
